explanation: The English article on the agreement says it "was reached to provide the basis for the ending of the civil war and the return to political normalcy in Lebanon" and that it "was designed to end the 15 year-long Lebanese Civil War". The accord exists because the war did. It is the war's settlement, which is also what Wikidata records (Q208484, P1542). The confidence is probable, because Wikipedia and Wikidata are the only sources here (rule 22).
